campaign.title: M2 UNBAL inverse-selector additive-reciprocity projective gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Audit vector-valued odd-character trace, large-sieve, and common-test theorems only against the exact centered matrix. Preserve theorem numbers and hypotheses, absolute-value placement, moduli, the complete h range, level pieces, projective/Sobolev/Bessel norms, endpoints, and every restored X-D-L-R-K power.

frozen_target.question: After applying exact additive reciprocity inside the already centered nonzero-frequency inverse-selector coefficient, before every positive modulus norm, can the shorter j-modulus support a signed common-test or low-projective-cost estimate for the full flat-smooth strict-UNBAL M2 owner, or do residue classes, long h, spectral levels, moving support, or restored norms repay the entire apparent gain?
frozen_target.reference_formula: R_circ(D,L;X)=sum_(g,n odd, gn asymp R) chi4(g) W(X/(gnD)) sum_(1<=h<n) gammahat_(g,n)(h) S^(chi4)_(infty,0)(4N0,h;2n), where gammahat_(g,n)(h)=n^(-1) sum_(j in J_(g,n),(j,n)=1) q_L(4Xj/(gn^2))/(gj) e(xi j/n) e(h inverse(n mod j)/j-h/(jn)). The target is O_epsilon(X^(1/4+epsilon)).
quantities: X=N0+xi, D=X^delta, L=X^ell, R=X/D, K=XL/D^2, Delta=D/L.
For a=delta-ell, the accepted flat envelope exponent is beta(a)=min(a,(1-a)/2)>1/4.
A complete method must save X^(a-1/4) for 1/4<a<=1/3 or X^((1-2a)/4) for 1/3<=a<1/2; at a=1/3 the missing factor is X^(1/12).
The reciprocity identity e(-h inverse(j mod n)/n)=e(h inverse(n mod j)/j-h/(jn)) is exact for every coprime j,n, including even j.
The h=0 row is already target-safe and is removed exactly once; all 1<=h<n remain.
Retain primitive g=1, arbitrary gcd(N0,n), both character directions, every two-adic class, the literal moving j-support and zero extension, real-centre factors, profiles, transitions, and endpoints.
Full h summation is a hostile control and must reconstruct the original reciprocal row exactly.
No result transfers outside this one flat-smooth strict-UNBAL owner.

Cover the primitive g=1 stratum and the complete long h range, not merely a short Linnik band or a fixed-h row.
If a trace formula or spectral large sieve is invoked, audit all level-4/8 holomorphic, Maass, exceptional, Eisenstein, cusp, and oldclass terms with literal theorem hypotheses.
Restore every X-D-L-R-K power and all moving-support and endpoint costs, and compare the net saving with the required boundary power.
Prove the target, prove an owner-complete strict range, or establish the smallest rigorous route-scoped reciprocity/projective capacity no-go.
Close under exactly one label: inverse_selector_reciprocity_target, strict_reciprocity_matrix_range, or inverse_selector_projective_capacity_no_go.

closing_assessment.main_result: Exact additive reciprocity preserves the full centered owner and complete h summation self-returns. The unweighted inverse-residue kernel has Gram matrix jI-11*, scalar projective inflation j^(1/2-o(1)), and full-range compression norm asymptotic to sqrt(Delta); both exceed the missing factor at every fixed strict point. This parks canonical scalar common-test routes but proves no weighted lower bound, vector impossibility, target, strict range, or exponent improvement.
